```yaml
name: Gitbook Docs Release
on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      tag:
        description: 'Release tag to process (e.g., v3.3.9)'
        required: true
        type: string

jobs:
  sync-gitbook:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'push' || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.event.inputs.tag != '')
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Git
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Extract version info
        id: version
        run: |
          if [[ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "workflow_dispatch" ]]; then
            TAG="${{ github.event.inputs.tag }}"
          else
            TAG="${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/}"
          fi
          
          MAJOR=$(echo "$TAG" | cut -d'.' -f1 | sed 's/v//')
          MINOR=$(echo "$TAG" | cut -d'.' -f2)
          PATCH=$(echo "$TAG" | cut -d'.' -f3)
          
          echo "tag=$TAG" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "major=$MAJOR" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "minor=$MINOR" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "patch=$PATCH" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "branch=docs/v${MAJOR}.${MINOR}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Create or update docs branch
        run: |
          BRANCH_NAME="${{ steps.version.outputs.branch }}"
          TAG_NAME="${{ steps.version.outputs.tag }}"
          git checkout -B "$BRANCH_NAME" "$TAG_NAME"
          git push origin "$BRANCH_NAME" --force

      - name: Create Gitbook variant (for x.y.0 releases)
        if: ${{ steps.version.outputs.patch == '0' }}
        env:
          GITBOOK_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITBOOK_TOKEN }}
          GITBOOK_SPACE_ID: ${{ secrets.GITBOOK_SPACE_ID }}
        run: |
          MAJOR="${{ steps.version.outputs.major }}"
          MINOR="${{ steps.version.outputs.minor }}"
          VARIANT_NAME="V${MAJOR}.${MINOR} - Rocky Romp"
          
          curl -X POST "https://api.gitbook.com/spaces/${GITBOOK_SPACE_ID}/variants" \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer ${GITBOOK_TOKEN}" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d '{
              "name": "'${VARIANT_NAME}'",
              "slug": "v'${MAJOR}'-'${MINOR}'",
              "source": {
                "type": "git",
                "repository": "https://github.com/erigontech/erigon",
                "branch": "docs/v'${MAJOR}'.'${MINOR}'"
              }
            }'
```
